senses.gloss: m. (זוּן) armament, armor, weapon (collect.), steel; כלי ז׳ implements of war.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 2:4">Tosef. Ab. Zar. II, 4</cite> <he>אין … לא ז׳ ולא כלי ז׳</he> you must not sell them either armor (steel) or implements &c.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 104a:11">Snh. 104ᵃ</cite> <he>ז׳ אוכל ז׳ וכ׳</he> he showed them steel consuming steel, i.e. the manufacture of hardened steel (cmp.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 96b">ib. 96ᵇ</cite>); <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:4:2">Cant. R. to III, 4</cite> <he>ז׳ בולע ז׳</he>. Tanḥ., ed. Bub., Lekh 23 <he>הריני חוגרו זְיָינִי</he> I will gird him with my (royal) armor.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:4">Cant. R. to IV, 4</cite>; Pesik. Naḥ., p. 124ᵇ, a. e., v. <cite ref="G00199"><he>זוֹנִי</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 45">Ex. R. s. 45</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="P00128"><he>עדי</he></cite>, <cite ref="Exodus 33:5">Ex. XXXIII, 5</cite>), cmp. <cite ref="G00199"><he>זוֹנִי</he></cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 25b">Ab. Zar. 25ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Yevamot 115a:3">Yeb. 115ᵃ</cite> <he>אשה כלי זַיְינָהּ עליה</he> a woman has her armor with her, i.e. her physical weakness is her protection from murderous attacks. [<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 4">Num. R. s. 4</cite>, end <he>בזֹינו</he>, v. <cite ref="G00199"><he>זוֹנִי</he></cite>.]—Pl. <he>זְיָינוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 47:1">Pirké d’R. El. ch. XLVII</cite>, beg.
